recent_articles.title: Mamata Banerjee, TMC: How one of India's most successful female politicians is losing her party
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Trinamool Congress (TMC), led by Mamata Banerjee, is experiencing a significant internal crisis following its loss in the recent West Bengal elections.  Banerjee's party has faced a rebellion from many of its legislators and MPs, who have accused her and her nephew of corruption and forging signatures on legislative documents. This has resulted in several TMC members seeking to align with the BJP-led ruling alliance. Political analysts suggest that this is part of a broader trend of regional parties becoming more centralized and family-centric, making them vulnerable after losing power. Banerjee remains defiant, but the future of the party remains uncertain.

recent_articles.title: INDIA bloc to take SIR complaints to CJI; seeks Pradhan’s immediate exit - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The INDIA bloc, led by **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge, met to discuss concerns over the special intensive revision (SIR) and alleged 'vote loot'. The meeting saw criticism of the Congress's handling of the recent Rajya Sabha election in Bihar, with leaders calling for a more concrete organizational structure.  The bloc also discussed the post-poll violence in West Bengal and called for an all-party meeting to address the current economic situation. **Mamata Banerjee**, who led the charge for unity after her party's defeat in the recent Assembly elections, urged the alliance to respond to youth protests under the banner of the Cockroach Janta Party.  The bloc will meet again in August.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool Congress Crisis Sharmila Sarkar: "20 Trinamool MPs Forming New Bloc, Will Support NDA": Rebel MP To NDTV
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kakoli Ghosh Dastidar** and 20 other **Trinamool Congress** MPs plan to join the **NDA coalition**, formally writing to Speaker **Om Birla**. The group, led by **Ghosh Dastidar** as chief whip, will form a separate bloc with **Shatabdi Roy** as deputy leader. This move follows similar actions in West Bengal where 58 MLAs formed a rival bloc, mirroring the Shiv Sena's strategy.  The decision comes after discussions and is seen as a response to Mamata Banerjee's leadership style and recent party decisions.

recent_articles.title: INDIA Bloc Meet Live Updates: Pointed Fingers Or Alliance Unity? All Eyes On Delhi Meeting
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **23** opposition parties are expected to meet in Delhi on Monday to discuss their strategy for the upcoming state and national elections. The meeting, called "Janbandhan," will focus on uniting against the **BJP** and addressing differences between alliance partners.  The **Congress**, **AAP**, **DMK**, and **TVK** are among the parties expected to attend.  **Mamata Banerjee** of the **TMC** is likely to raise concerns about attacks on her party's leaders in Bengal, while **John Brittas** of the **CPI(M)** will address alleged political understanding between the Left and the **BJP** during the Kerala polls.

recent_articles.title: DMK absent, allies restive, INDIA bloc braces for a difficult conversation at today’s meeting | Political Pulse News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Opposition INDIA bloc is set to meet in Delhi on Monday, facing a weakened position after the recent Assembly elections and internal tensions. The absence of the DMK due to its disagreement with the Congress over the Tamil Nadu government's formation has added to the complexity.  **Mamata Banerjee**, **Abhishek Banerjee**, and other leaders are expected to play a mediating role as the bloc grapples with issues including electoral rolls, delimitation, simultaneous elections, education system concerns, and coordination.

recent_articles.title: Mrinaltai Gore Flyover draws flak within a day of inauguration | Mumbai News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The newly opened Mrinaltai Gore Flyover in Mumbai has faced criticism from citizens, activists, and opposition leaders over its uneven road surface.  **Shiv Sena (UBT)** leader and Worli MLA **Aaditya Thackeray** expressed concern about the quality of construction on social media. The **Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC)** defended the project, stating that the unevenness is due to expansion joints designed to absorb temperature fluctuations. They also denied claims of patchwork and assured that the road surface will settle over time.  The flyover's opening comes amidst a series of other BMC infrastructure projects facing criticism for quality issues.

recent_articles.title: Mrinaltai Gore Flyover draws flak within a day of inauguration | Mumbai News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Opposition leaders, activists, and citizens have criticized the newly opened Mrinaltai Gore Flyover in Mumbai for its uneven road surface.  The project, costing ₹247.97 crore, faced scrutiny after videos surfaced online showing sections of the flyover with visible wear and tear. The **Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC)** defended the construction, claiming that the unevenness is due to expansion joints designed to absorb temperature fluctuations. However, critics questioned the quality of work and called for transparency from the BMC regarding cost escalations and delays. This incident follows a pattern of criticism directed at other recent BMC infrastructure projects in Mumbai.

recent_articles.title: ‘Will introduce Bill in Parliament to stop horse-trading’: Supriya Sule after Maharashtra MLC poll row | Pune News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Supriya Sule**, **Devendra Fadnavis**, and other political figures in Maharashtra are engaged in a heated debate following the unopposed victories of the ruling Mahayuti alliance in the June 18 Legislative Council elections.  Sule, representing the NCP-SP, proposed a bill to increase transparency in elections and called for either discontinuing these elections or open voting. Fadnavis responded that he believes people can be won over with love rather than money but would support reforms to the election process. The withdrawal of several MVA candidates from the Pune seat due to allegations of horse-trading has sparked further controversy, with Sule accusing the ruling parties of using their power for manipulation and calling for a democratic electoral system.  She plans to attend the INDIA bloc meeting on June 8th.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool Congress West Bengal MLA Ritabrata Banerjee To NDTV On What Next, "Backstabber" Label
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ritabrata Banerjee**, expelled Trinamool Congress MLA, is challenging the **Calcutta High Court** recognition of a rebel bloc as the main Opposition party in West Bengal.  **Kalyan Banerjee**, a senior Trinamool MP, has filed a petition contesting his claim to the post. **Ritabrata Banerjee** alleges forged signatures on party documents and claims that the rebel bloc's strength is higher than what was publicly acknowledged. The case hinges on whether the political party or the legislature party appoints the whip and leader, with parallels drawn from the Maharashtra political saga.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool Congress West Bengal MLA Ritabrata Banerjee To NDTV On What Next, "Backstabber" Label
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ritabrata Banerjee**, expelled Trinamool Congress MLA, is challenging the recognition of a rebel bloc as the main Opposition party in West Bengal's assembly. **Kalyan Banerjee**, a senior Trinamool MP and lawyer, filed a petition in the Calcutta High Court contesting the Speaker's decision. **Ritabrata Banerjee** alleges forged signatures on party documents and claims that the rebellion is a result of a "boss culture" and mistreatment by Abhishek Banerjee, who he credits with bringing him into the Trinamool. He also suggests that former Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee should remain as "chief advisor" to the rebel bloc despite her criticism of his actions.

recent_articles.title: ‘Will introduce a Bill in Parliament to stop horse-trading’: Supriya Sule after Maharashtra MLC poll row | Pune News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the withdrawal of several candidates from the Maharashtra Legislative Council elections, **Supriya Sule** and **Devendra Fadnavis** engaged in a heated exchange.  Sule proposed a bill to increase transparency in elections, advocating for either discontinuing these elections or open voting.  Fadnavis expressed support for reform but believed that love could win over voters rather than money. The ruling Mahayuti alliance won unopposed victories in six seats, with **Vikram Kakade** elected unopposed in Pune after the NCP withdrew due to allegations of horse-trading. Sule criticized the ruling parties' reliance on financial power and vowed to fight them in future elections.  The Congress accused the NCP (SP) of betrayal for withdrawing from the Pune seat.

recent_articles.title: 40 years ago, June 6, 1986: Haryana ministry sworn in | The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bansi Lal**, the new chief minister of **Haryana**, swore in a 13-member, two-tier ministry and declared that Chandigarh would remain the state's capital for at least five years.  Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi planted a "Tree for Peace" at Indira Gandhi's memorial on World Environment Day, urging a nationwide movement to protect the environment. recent_articles.title: 40 years ago, June 6, 1986: Haryana ministry sworn in | The Indian Express

recent_articles.title: Mahayuti likely to win six MLC seats unopposed - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Maharashtra** witnessed a significant shift in the legislative council polls with several candidates withdrawing their nominations, paving the way for Mahayuti to secure six unopposed seats. **NCP** candidate Aniket Tatkare is likely to win uncontested in Ratnagiri after **Bal Mane**, a Shiv Sena (UBT) candidate, withdrew his nomination.  The withdrawal of other candidates from various constituencies also contributed to this outcome. The Election Commission of India will hold the elections on June 18th with results expected on June 22nd.

recent_articles.title: Aaditya Thackeray, BJP’s Ameet Satam trade barbs over Andheri subway flooding | Mumbai News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following heavy rainfall that caused the Andheri subway to close on Wednesday, a political dispute erupted between **Shiv Sena (UBT)**'s Aaditya Thackeray and **BJP**'s Mumbai chief Ameet Satam.  Thackeray accused the ruling Mahayuti alliance of failing to implement rainwater holding tanks despite being in power for four years, while Satam argued that comparing the Andheri incident with other subway flooding was unfair due to different problems. The incident drew criticism from Congress MP Varsha Gaikwad and party leader Sachin Sawant who questioned the **BMC**'s monsoon preparedness.

recent_articles.title: Seeking Centre’s intervention, Aaditya alleges state diluted tiger corridor for mining project | Mumbai News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Shiv Sena (UBT)** MLA Aaditya Thackeray accused the **Maharashtra** government of diluting a tiger corridor in Gadchiroli district to facilitate a mining project.  Thackeray demanded the cancellation of the mining permission and the dissolution of the State Board for Wildlife, alleging that the state government is prioritizing commercial interests over environmental protection. He also questioned the authority of the SBWL to approve such decisions and called for an independent investigation into the matter.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal Trinamool Chaos: Has Mamata Banerjee Reached Her Political Endgame?
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Trinamool Congress (TMC) is facing a severe internal crisis following its loss in the recent West Bengal Assembly elections.  **Mamata Banerjee**, despite retaining her personal appeal, faces a fractured party with 58 MLAs supporting expelled leader **Ritabrata Banerjee** as Leader of the Opposition. The party's organizational structure has been significantly weakened by allegations of centralized control and corporate-style management. **Abhishek Banerjee**, Mamata's nephew and national general secretary, is facing criticism for his leadership style, further exacerbating the internal conflict.  The TMC's future hinges on whether **Mamata Banerjee** can address these issues and rebuild the party from the grassroots level or if it will fragment into irrelevance.

recent_articles.title: Shiv Sena's "Slow Poison" Barb Gets BJP's "Begani Shaadi..." Retort
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Shiv Sena** leader Abdul Sattar accused the **BJP** of weakening the party at the grassroots level, warning that this could lead to problems for the Mahayuti alliance.  Sattar criticized the BJP's expansion within Maharashtra and claimed it was damaging the Shiv Sena's organizational base. He also expressed concern about the future of the alliance, suggesting that if corrective steps are not taken, they may face issues in 2029. Sattar urged the BJP to stop this "slow poison" and emphasized the need for a united Shiv Sena.  The dispute escalated after Sattar's son filed a rebel nomination for the upcoming Legislative Council election.

recent_articles.title: Expelled Trinamool Rebel Ritabrata Banerjee Becomes Leader Of Opposition In Bengal
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Speaker Rathindra Bose** approved **Ritabrata Banerjee**, a rebel leader, as the Leader of the Opposition in West Bengal's assembly.  **Firhad Hakim**, a key aide to **Mamata Banerjee**, resigned as Kolkata Mayor amidst turmoil within the Trinamool Congress. The party dissolved all its committees and frontal organizations, claiming introspection is necessary. **Ritabrata Banerjee** asserted that he has the support of 59 of the party's 80 MLAs and claimed **Mamata Banerjee** is the leader of the faction.  The events appear to follow a similar pattern as Maharashtra's political upheaval involving the Shiv Sena and NCP, with the Trinamool Congress alleging BJP involvement in the split.

recent_articles.title: Ashok Vada Pav ranks 25th in TasteAtlas' Most Iconic Sandwiches List
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **TasteAtlas**, a popular food guide, ranked Mumbai's Ashok Vada Pav 25th in its list of The World’s Most Iconic Sandwiches.  The snack, believed to have been invented by street vendor **Ashok Vaidya** in the 1960s or 70s, is an iconic street food staple in Mumbai, known for its affordability and convenience. Celebrity chef **Ananya Banerjee** highlighted the dish's cultural significance as a symbol of Mumbai's industrious spirit.  **Tarveen Kaur**, head chef and restaurant consultant, agreed that vada pav represents the essence of Mumbai, a simple yet profound snack with enduring popularity across India.

recent_articles.title: 'Maharashtra Model' In West Bengal? Buzz Over New Trinamool Congress Without Mamata Banerjee
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Trinamool Congress** (TMC) is facing internal dissent following the expulsion of two whistleblower MLAs, Ritabrata Bandopadhyay and Sandipan Saha.  About 60 out of 80 **Trinamool** MLAs missed a meeting at **Mamata Banerjee's** house, raising concerns over party loyalty and unity. **Mamata Banerjee** accused the BJP of attempting to poach her MLAs with intimidation and financial inducements. Some MLAs have met separately, fueling speculation about potential party splits.

recent_articles.title: Twelve years of dedication, a legacy of achievement - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** received accolades from Norway and Sweden, joining a list of 32 international honors he has been awarded during his 12-year term.  His leadership has been praised for its focus on national development, with achievements including economic reforms, infrastructure projects, and initiatives aimed at empowering women and farmers. The Shiv Sena, a political party within the National Democratic Alliance, continues to support **Modi**, recognizing his dedication to the nation's progress. Despite facing criticism from the opposition, **Modi** remains committed to serving the people and has implemented policies that have improved the lives of millions.  His unwavering commitment to India's development and strong leadership style have earned him widespread admiration both domestically and internationally.

recent_articles.title: Legislative Council election: Seat sharing finalised but Mahayuti and MVA camps yet to announce candidates | Mumbai News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mahayuti** and **Opposition MVA** alliances have finalized seat sharing agreements for the upcoming legislative council elections, but have yet to disclose most candidate names. The **BJP**, **Shiv Sena**, and **NCP** reached an agreement on 17 seats, with the **BJP** securing 11, **Shiv Sena** receiving 4, and the **NCP** getting 2. The disputes between the alliances revolve around seat allocation in specific districts, particularly over Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar —Jalna and Raigad-Ratnagiri-Sindhudurg.  The final candidate lists are expected to be announced on June 1st.

recent_articles.title: Tribuneindia... Bollywood Bhelpuri
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ajay Devgun**, **Manisha Koirala**, **Saif Ali Khan**, and **Namrata Shirodkar** star in the new film "Kachche Dhaage," which features music by the late **Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan**.  **Ruby Bhatia**, **Laila**, and **Divya (Palat)** have also secured roles in upcoming films. **Kajol**'s future wedding plans remain unclear, despite her previous pronouncements. The Bollywood community came together to raise funds for AIDS awareness at a recent event organized by **Smita Thackeray**.

recent_articles.title: CBSE OSM Coempt TCS row | CBSE on screen marking row: Rahul Gandhi says ‘rules’ bent to favour Coempt, cites TCS loss in auction - Telegraph India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi** criticized the **Modi government** over the CBSE exam evaluation controversy, alleging that the board lowered technical requirements to favor **COEMPT Eduteck Private Limited**, a company with a poor track record. He demanded an independent judicial probe into the contract awarding process and accused the government of prioritizing its survival over student well-being.  **Piyush Goyal**, the Union commerce minister, countered Gandhi's claims, accusing him of "propaganda" while **Dharmendra Pradhan**, the Union education minister, defended the board's actions. Other prominent figures like **Priyanka Chaturvedi** and **Mohammed Zubair** have also raised concerns about potential manipulation and a coordinated campaign to promote the OSM system.

recent_articles.title: Abhishek Banerjee heckled | TMC leader Abhishek Banerjee allegedly manhandled by agitating locals at Sonarpur in Bengal's South 24 Parganas: Police - Telegraph India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, **Trinamool Congress** national general secretary, was physically attacked by a mob in Sonarpur, West Bengal, while visiting families of post-poll violence victims.  The incident occurred after he arrived to meet the family of Sanju Karmakar, a victim of the violence.  Local residents shouted "thief" slogans and hurled objects at him. **Derek O'Brien**, leader of Trinamool in Rajya Sabha, condemned the attack and called for action from the police. Opposition leaders across parties, including **Samik Bhattacharya** (BJP), **Mallikarjun Kharge** (Congress), **Akhilesh Yadav** (SP), **Arvind Kejriwal** (AAP), and **Tejashwi Yadav** (RJD), condemned the attack on Banerjee and called for an end to political violence.

recent_articles.title: Lok Sabha election 2024: Maharashtra get interesting after splits in Shiv Sena, NCP - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The upcoming Lok Sabha elections in Maharashtra will be influenced by splits within the Shiv Sena and NCP, along with traditional issues like unemployment and farmer suicides. The BJP-Shiv Sena alliance won 41 of the 48 seats in 2019, but the split has shifted the political landscape.  **Eknath Shinde** leads the ruling alliance in Maharashtra, while Ajit Pawar joined the alliance after splitting from the NCP. **Manoj Jarange**, a Maratha quota activist, is gaining traction in Marathwada. The region will be crucial to watch as it has traditionally been a stronghold for the BJP-Shiv Sena.  The elections are scheduled across five phases between April 19 and May 20 with counting on June 4. Over 9.2 crore citizens are eligible to vote, an increase of 34 lakh from 2019.

recent_articles.title: Spurious liquor kills 15 in Pune, Pimpri-Chinchwad; 8 held, probe ordered - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: At least 15 people have died in Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad after consuming spurious liquor, prompting an investigation by **Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** and the **Excise Department**.  **Yogesh Wankhede**, who brought ethanol without permission, is suspected of preparing the illicit alcohol at a location in Hadapsar before supplying it to vendors. The deaths occurred over three days, with residents expressing anger towards authorities for allegedly failing to prevent the sale of illegal liquor.  The investigation is ongoing and more arrests are expected.

recent_articles.title: Rajya Sabha defections, constitutional questions - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Seven **Aam Aadmi Party** (AAP) MPs announced on April 24, 2026, that over two-thirds of their party's members had merged with the **Bharatiya Janata Party** (BJP), invoking the 10th Schedule of the Constitution. This move has drawn attention to constitutional questions regarding the interpretation of anti-defection laws and the scope of the "merger" exception.  This event, occurring at the national level in the Rajya Sabha, carries significant political consequences.

recent_articles.title: Court allows police interrogation of Shiv Sena MLA Sanjay Gaikwad over threat to publisher - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Kolhapur** court has granted permission for police to question Shiv Sena MLA Sanjay Gaikwad in connection with threats made against publisher Prashant Ambi regarding the book "Who was Shivaji?".  Gaikwad, who had previously objected to the use of the word "Shivaji" in the book and threatened Ambi, now regrets his abusive language but maintains he will continue to oppose books critical of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. The incident dates back to 1988 when the book was published, and Mr. Ambi has received threatening calls since then.  The case is expected to proceed with a notice issued by the Rajarampuri police station directing Gaikwad to appear for questioning or submit a written response.

recent_articles.title: 12 MPs, four Parliamentary panels selected for Sansad Ratna Awards - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Prime Point Foundation** has selected **12 MPs** and four Parliamentary Committees for this year's Sansad Ratna Awards.  **Jagdambika Pal**, **P.P. Chaudhary**, **Nishikant Dubey**, and **Shrikant Eknath Shinde** are among the individuals recognized, while the **Committee on Agriculture**, **Finance Committee**, **Rural Development and Panchayati Raj Committee**, and **Coal and Mines Committee** have also been awarded for their performance.

recent_articles.title: Tell your ‘petty politicians’ not to blame the court for delay, CJI tells Thackeray-Shinde factions - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** expressed frustration with the "petty politicians" of the Uddhav Thackeray and Eknath Shinde factions of the Shiv Sena for making accusations against the court regarding delays in their dispute over the party symbol.  Chief Justice of India Surya Kant criticized the parties' media statements, urging them to refrain from such actions. Senior advocate Mukul Rohatgi, representing the Shinde faction, acknowledged that irresponsible comments were made and urged the court to set a specific date for final arguments. The case, which has been pending for years, centers on the Election Commission's February 2023 order assigning the symbol 'bow and arrow' to the Shinde faction, challenging the Thackeray faction's claim to the party name and symbol.

recent_articles.title: Ten new MLCs sworn in at Maharashtra Vidhan Bhavan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ten newly elected members of the Maharashtra Legislative Council (MLC)** took their oaths on Thursday, May 14, 2026, following the end of nine sitting MLCs' terms. The new members include representatives from the **BJP**, **Shiv Sena**, and **NCP**.  The ceremony was presided over by **Legislative Council chairperson Ram Shinde** and attended by key figures like **Assembly Speaker Rahul Narwekar**, **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis**, and **Deputy Chief Ministers Eknath Shinde and Sunetra Ajit**. The Upper House currently has 22 vacancies, with the majority of seats held by the **BJP** due to their dominance in the Legislative Assembly.

recent_articles.title: ​Split wide open: On the AIADMK, Tamil Nadu politics - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **AIADMK**, the principal opposition party in Tamil Nadu, is facing a split after a second consecutive election defeat.  **C. Joseph Vijay**, the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, has indicated his support for the dissident group led by former Ministers **C.Ve. Shanmugam** and **S.P. Velumani**. Palaniswami** as the AIADMK legislature party leader, citing a Supreme Court verdict in the Shiv Sena case. The Assembly Speaker will need to assess the merits of both groups' claims and may soon have to draw on his experience and legal advice.

recent_articles.title: What does the BJP’s victory in West Bengal mean for India’s democracy? | Elections | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** has won the West Bengal state assembly elections, marking a significant shift in Indian politics.  Critics argue that controversial electoral roll changes played a role in the BJP's landslide victory, raising concerns about the future of democracy and its impact on India's Muslim population. The outcome could reshape national politics for 200 million Muslims.

recent_articles.title: ‘Defeated by conspiracy’: West Bengal chief minister refuses to resign after election loss | India | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, India's most powerful female politician, has refused to resign as chief minister of West Bengal despite the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** winning a landslide victory in state elections.  Banerjee claims the election was "looted" by conspiracy and that she will not step down. The governor of West Bengal has threatened to send police if Banerjee does not voluntarily relinquish her position, potentially leading to legal challenges. The BJP has responded with accusations of "constitutional blasphemy" and a ban on advisors appointed by Banerjee from entering their offices.  Banerjee's refusal to step down could lead to further political turmoil in the state.

recent_articles.title: Maharashtra Legislative Council elections to be unopposed as Congress backtracks, Shinde fields two candidates - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** has withdrawn its decision to field a candidate for the nine Legislative Council seats in Maharashtra, supporting **Ambadas Danve** from **Shiv Sena UBT** after marathon meetings and phone calls between top leaders.  The decision was announced by **Maharashtra Congress president Harshawardhan Sapkal**, who also spoke alongside leaders of the Maha Vikas Aghadi. After a day of speculation, nine candidates filed their nominations for the seats, with each party securing its allotted quota.

recent_articles.title: Fadnavis backs ex-CJI amid row over meeting with Dhirendra Shastri - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Devendra Fadnavis**, **Maharashtra Chief Minister**,  came out in support of former Chief Justice of India (CJI) B.R. Gavai after social activist Shyam Manav criticized his meeting with Dhirendra Shastri, chief priest of the Bageshwar Dham.  Manav argued that Gavai should not claim the legacy of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar and challenged Shastri to accept an anti-superstition panel's challenge. Senior Congress leader Vijay Wadettiwar accused political leaders of elevating babas (religious figures) in Maharashtra, criticizing Gavai for meeting Shastri.  The controversy comes after a similar incident involving Shastri's claims about Shivaji Maharaj.

recent_articles.title: No secret meeting took place with Uddhav Thackeray, says Devendra Fadnavis - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Devendra Fadnavis**, the **Maharashtra** Chief Minister, denied meeting **Uddhav Thackeray** despite reports of a secret meeting.  He stated that false news is being spread and action will be taken against those spreading it.  Fadnavis also addressed comments made by Dheerendra Shastri regarding historical meetings between Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and Samarth Ramdas, stating there's no historical evidence to support such claims. He emphasized the importance of responsible reactions and avoiding unnecessary controversy.

recent_articles.title: Face-off between MNS and Shiv Sena leader Nirupam over mandatory Marathi for autorickshaw and taxi drivers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A protest erupted in Mumbai on Friday over a new mandatory Marathi language proficiency requirement for licensed autorickshaw and taxi drivers in Maharashtra, effective May 1st.  **Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS)** party functionaries clashed with **Shiv Sena leader Sanjay Nirupam**, who had appealed to the state government to reconsider the move. The protest escalated with MNS party members allegedly throwing stones at Mr. Nirupam's car.

recent_articles.title: BJP to contest four seats in upcoming Maharashtra Legislative Council polls - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **BJP** will contest four of the nine seats in the upcoming Maharashtra Legislative Council biennial elections, scheduled for May 12. The party's strategy was discussed at a meeting led by Chief Minister **Devendra Fadnavis**.  Candidates for the by-election for the seat vacated by Pradnya Satav are being shortlisted and will be sent to the central leadership for approval.  The Election Commission of India has set a quota of 29 votes for each council seat, with the by-election requiring 144 votes.

recent_articles.title: Baramati, Rahuri all set to conduct byelections on April 23 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Maharashtra** is holding by-elections in two constituencies, Baramati and Rahuri, on April 23, 2026.  The **Congress** withdrew its candidate from Baramati, paving the way for Deputy Chief Minister Sunetra Pawar to contest. The Baramati by-election is significant as it marks the first election since the death of the former MLA, Ajit Pawar. In Rahuri, the BJP's Akshay Kardile faces off against NCP-SP candidate Govind Mokate from the **Maha Vikas Aghadi**.

recent_articles.title: Mahayuti to launch signature campaign in Maharashtra on Women’s Reservation Bill - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The ruling Mahayuti** party in Maharashtra is launching a signature campaign from April 21 to collect one crore signatures of women, protesting the recent defeat of the Women’s Reservation Bill and Delimitation Bill. **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** challenged the opposition parties for an open debate on the issue, accusing them of stalling increased women's reservation and SC/ST reservations.  **Supriya Sule**, an NCP SP MP, and **Praniti Shinde**, a Congress MP, accepted the challenge, while **Rahul Gandhi**, the Congress leader, was accused by Fadnavis of being a liar. The opposition parties countered that the government is trying to use the issue for political gain ahead of elections in West Bengal and Tamil Nadu.

recent_articles.title: Chaturvedi’s grumbling over defeat of Women’s Bill’ flies in the face of her party’s stand - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Shiv Sena UBT** leader Priyanka Chaturvedi criticized the defeat of the Women’s Reservation Bill in the Lok Sabha, expressing her opposition to its inclusion with the Delimitation Bill. **Sanjay Raut**, a Shiv Sena UBT MP, stated that the party opposed the bill because it was presented as a means for the BJP to advance their own agenda. Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis condemned the opposition's actions, calling them hypocritical and stating that they prioritized politics over progress.

recent_articles.title: INDIA bloc opposes Delimitation Bill - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mallikarjun Kharge**, president of the **All India Congress Committee (AICC)**, announced that the INDIA bloc has unanimously decided to oppose the Delimitation Bill.  **Kharge** stated that opposition parties are not against the Women’s Reservation Bill but are concerned about the bill's linking with delimitation and seat increases in State Assemblies. Several Opposition leaders, including **T.R. Baalu**, **Tejashwi Yadav**, and **Sanjay Raut**, expressed their opposition to the Delimitation Bill.

recent_articles.title: Discontinue Ladki Bahin if government doesn’t have funds for pension: Bombay HC - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bombay High Court** criticized the Maharashtra government for its financial mismanagement, stating that the **Mahayuti government's** flagship scheme, the **Ladki Bahin Yojana**, should be discontinued if it cannot afford to pay pensions to retired employees. The court questioned the government's priorities and demanded an explanation for the non-payment of pension dues by the **Additional Commissioner**.  The court also urged the government to consider selling assets like tables, chairs, and cars to fund employee pensions.

recent_articles.title: Why did the Congress withdraw its candidate from Baramati at the last minute? - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **NCP** and **NCP(SP)** leaders, including Sunetra Pawar, met with **Maharashtra Congress** president Harshawardhan Sapkal to request the withdrawal of their candidate from the Baramati by-election.  The Pawars argued for a united front against a competing candidate, while **Congress** leaders expressed disappointment over the lack of outreach from the **NCP**. The **Congress** eventually backed down and agreed to withdraw its candidate in response to pressure from allies and the **Pawar family**.

recent_articles.title: Battle for Baramati: Sunetra Pawar files nomination, Sharad Pawar’s photo displayed during NCP rally - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sunetra Pawar**, daughter of **Sharad Pawar**, filed her nomination as the Nationalist Congress Party candidate for the upcoming Baramati by-election.  She was accompanied by Deputy Chief Minister **Eknath Shinde** and BJP cabinet minister **Chandrashekhar Bawankule**. **Sharad Pawar** expressed disapproval of his photo being displayed alongside **Narendra Modi** and **Amit Shah**, stating that it was wrong to do so. While senior NCP leaders, **Praful Patel** and **Sunil Tatkare**, suggested speaking with the Congress leadership for an unopposed election, Sunetra Pawar's son, **Parth**, indicated he would not engage in such negotiations.  **Sanjay Raut** of Shiv Sena UBT expressed that it was acceptable to field a candidate in elections.

recent_articles.title: MVA rift: Uddhav likely to back Sunetra Pawar in Baramati bypoll, but Congress not on board - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Congress** broke with its MVA partners, declaring it would contest the upcoming Baramati Assembly by-election.  **Sunetra Pawar**, widow of deceased NCP leader **Ajit Pawar**, is the ruling alliance's candidate. **Shiv Sena (UBT)** chief **Uddhav Thackeray** is expected to announce his party's decision soon, with sources indicating a likely support for **Sunetra Pawar**.  The Congress, however, has decided to contest the by-election independently, citing a lack of communication and participation in alliance discussions.

recent_articles.title: Sunetra Pawar to file nomination on April 6, contest won’t be unopposed in Baramati - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sunetra Pawar**, the Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra, will file her nomination for the Baramati by-election on April 6th. The seat fell vacant after the death of her husband **Ajit Pawar** in an air crash earlier this year.  The election is expected to test the unity of the opposition Maha Vikas Aghadi alliance as allies may compete against each other. While the Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) has declared it will not field a candidate against Sunetra Pawar, the Maharashtra Congress and Shiv Sena UBT have expressed their intention to support a candidate in Baramati.

recent_articles.title: ‘On Kharat’s call list, DCM Eknath Shinde, Minister Shirsat, Uddhav’s close aide Milind Narvekar’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Anjali Damania**, a social activist, claims that **Eknath Shinde**, **Sanjay Shirsat**, **Milind Narvekar**, and other prominent politicians were on the call list of arrested godman **Ashok Kharat**.  Damania based her claim on a CDR she possesses, stating that there were 17 calls between **Shinde** and **Kharat**, with one call lasting for 21 minutes. **Rupali Chakankar**, an NCP leader, had the most frequent conversations with **Kharat**, followed by his sister and other high-profile individuals like **Sunil Tatkare**, **Chandrakant Patil**, and **Ashish Shelar**.

recent_articles.title: Pednekar Withdraws Proposal to Include Manache Shlok in BMC Schools After MIM Opposition - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kishori Pednekar**, a leader of the Uddhav Thackeray-led Shiv Sena faction, withdrew a proposal to make the Manache Shlok, a composition by Samarth Ramdas Swami, part of the curriculum in schools run by the **Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation** after **AIMIM** raised objections.  **Vijay Ubale**, the AIMIM group leader, argued that schools should not mandate teachings from any one religion and instead focus on constitutional values and fundamental duties. Pednekar expressed regret for her previous remarks connecting the text to Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar and clarified that she did not intend to imply the Manache Shlok belonged solely to Hindus.

recent_articles.title: Shiv Sena (UBT) open to alliance with MNS for Maharashtra’s benefit, says Sanjay Raut - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sharad Pawar**, NCP (SP) chief, and six other candidates from the **Mahayuti alliance** filed nominations for seven Rajya Sabha seats in Maharashtra.  The ruling coalition's nominees are expected to be elected unopposed due to a lack of opposition. **Sanjay Raut**, Shiv Sena (UBT) leader, stated his party is willing to make concessions for the benefit of Maharashtra and its Marathi-speaking population.

recent_articles.title: Shiv Sena slams Kalaburagi City Corporation for resolution on dead Iranian leader - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Shiv Sena** state president Siddalinga Swami criticized **Kalaburagi City Corporation** officials for passing a condolence resolution honoring Iran’s deceased supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei during their budget meeting.  Swami questioned the appropriateness of paying tribute to a foreign leader in a civic body setting, citing concerns about human rights violations in Iran and urging legal action against those who supported the resolution. He also criticized the BJP councillors for not objecting and demanded that the corporation focus on local issues.

recent_articles.title: NDA, Opposition spar in LS over efforts to free country of Maoism - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **BJP** and **NDA** members in the Lok Sabha criticized the previous **UPA** government for its handling of Maoism, accusing it of failing to contain the threat.  They highlighted significant reductions in the "red corridor" under the current administration and emphasized the success of policies like Operation Green Hunt and the creation of CoBRA. The Congress countered by pointing to efforts made during their tenure, including the establishment of the Commando Battalion for Resolute Action (CoBRA) and emphasizing a balanced approach that prioritized both security and welfare.  The debate highlighted contrasting approaches to combating Maoism between the two governments.

recent_articles.title: Parliament Budget Session LIVE: Lok Sabha to discuss Insolvency, Bankruptcy Code Bill; Rajya Sabha to take up CAPF Bill - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Lok Sabha** will continue discussions on the **Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (Amendment) Bill, 2025** on Monday, March 30, 2026. The bill aims to address delays in insolvency proceedings and introduce procedural amendments.  Additionally, the House is expected to discuss the government's efforts to combat left-wing extremism, with a deadline of March 2026 set by **Union Home Minister Amit Shah** for achieving Naxal-free India.

recent_articles.title: Tamil Nadu’s Nitish Kumar or assertive chief? Edappadi Palaniswami confronts a battle of perceptions - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Edappadi K. Palaniswami**, the general secretary of the **AIADMK**, is facing a political battle in Tamil Nadu's upcoming Assembly election, with his rivals, particularly the ruling **DMK**, accusing him of being subservient to the **BJP**.  The DMK has framed the election as a contest between Tamil Nadu and New Delhi, highlighting Palaniswami's decision to embrace certain Central schemes that were opposed by former leader **Jayalalithaa**. To counter these accusations, Palaniswami has taken steps to assert his authority within the NDA alliance, including meeting with key BJP leaders and announcing seat-sharing arrangements. The outcome of this battle will be determined on May 4th when the votes are counted.

recent_articles.title: Discharge of untreated water into sea has caused marine pollution: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC)** Additional Municipal Commissioner (Projects) Abhijit Bangar announced that all seven sewage treatment plants (STPs) are expected to be operational by 2027, with the Mahul pumping station land issue resolved.  However, the Mogra Pumping Station faces challenges due to its location within the coastal road alignment, requiring approval from the Coastal Zone Authority. Concerns were raised in the BMC house regarding the unoperational Gajdharbandh STP and its impact on marine ecosystems and fishermen's livelihoods. **Shiv Sena (UBT)** corporators urged for immediate action to address the sewage issue.

recent_articles.title: Transgender bill passed by voice vote in Lok Sabha - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Lok Sabha** passed the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Amendment Bill, 2026, by voice vote. The bill aims to redefine "transgender person" based on biological or physiological markers and socio-cultural identities, while opposition parties like the Congress, DMK, and SP argued that it violates basic human rights and undermines self-determination.  The government defended the bill as necessary for providing safety and benefits to the transgender community.

recent_articles.title: Govt revs up consultations on early implementation of Women’s Reservation Act - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Narendra Modi** government announced plans to amend the Women’s Reservation Act, 2023 to implement its provisions for the 2029 Lok Sabha election. The amendment will reserve one-third of seats in Parliament and State Assemblies for women based on the 2011 Census data.  The **Union Home Minister Amit Shah** met with leaders from various Opposition parties including the Nationalist Congress Party, YSR Congress Party, All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen, and Shiv Sena (UBT) to discuss the proposed amendments. The government aims to introduce these amendments in Parliament during the ongoing Budget Session or a Special Session later this year.

recent_articles.title: Rupali Chakankar’s exit not enough; probe must target ‘big fish’, says Congress leader - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Vijay Wadettiwar**, Congress leader, criticized **Rupali Chakankar's** resignation as Maharashtra State Commission for Women chairperson over her links to a rape-accused 'godman', demanding action against those involved. He alleged attempts to shield influential individuals linked to the self-styled godman **Ashok Kharat**, who was arrested this week in Nashik, and called for a comprehensive investigation into the case, including examining call detail records of all those in contact with Kharat. Wadettiwar also criticized the state government's handling of the situation and alleged attempts to suppress the case.

recent_articles.title: Under fire over links with rape accused godman, Maharashtra women’s panel chief quits - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rupali Chakankar**, chairperson of the **Maharashtra State Commission for Women**, resigned after facing pressure to step down following her association with accused rape-accused ‘godman’ Ashok Kharat.  Chakankar was summoned to the official residence of **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** and was asked to resign due to public outcry over the photos and videos that surfaced showing her interacting with Kharat. The opposition criticized the government's delayed action, alleging a lack of coordination within the Mahayuti alliance and suggesting Chakankar’s resignation is part of a larger power play by the BJP.

recent_articles.title: How Maharashtra Legislature cleared the Freedom of Religion Bill, and why most of the opposition parties did not oppose it - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Maharashtra** legislature passed the Freedom of Religion Bill, making it the 13th state in India to have such legislation.  While the bill was supported by opposition parties like the Shiv Sena UBT and NCP SP, concerns were raised about its potential infringement on religious freedom and lack of empirical data to justify its need. The bill aims to crack down on forced conversions but has faced criticism from Congress MLA Aslam Sheikh who called it regressive and a one-sided target against a particular community.  **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis**, however, argued that the current legal framework was insufficient to handle the law and order situation caused by such cases.

recent_articles.title: Freedom of Religion Bill passed in Maharashtra Assembly; 'not against any community', says Fadnavis - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Maharashtra Assembly passed the Freedom of Religion Bill 2026, which prohibits religious conversions through coercion, fraud, or inducement. The bill mandates a seven-year prison sentence and ₹1 lakh fine for those involved in unlawful conversions, with increased penalties for minors, vulnerable groups, and repeat offenders.  **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** emphasized the bill's aim to protect citizens from fraudulent conversions while safeguarding constitutional rights. Opposition parties raised concerns about potential "vigilantism" and the bill's impact on religious freedom.

recent_articles.title: No shortage of LPG, Oppn. creating panic among public, says Fadnavis - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article:
##  Fadnavis Blames Congress for LPG Shortages, Denies Supply Crisis

Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis has refuted claims of an LPG shortage in the state, blaming the opposition Congress for creating panic and long queues at distribution centers. He insists that there is no actual shortage but rather a result of misinformation spread by the Congress. Fadnavis accused the party of misleading the public and insulting Prime Minister Narendra Modi while speaking to reporters.  The situation has been further complicated by price hikes, technical issues with booking cylinders, delays in deliveries, and a restricted commercial supply for the hospitality sector. 

Congress members have criticized the government's handling of the crisis, pointing to the shutdowns of numerous hotels due to the shortage. They also questioned the Prime Minister's silence on the issue, highlighting his past successes in uniting international leaders.
